method: Static analysis only (checks + triage; no fixes, no cargo builds, no driver runs, no oracle repairs, no commits - the coordinator commits). javap -c on the named 26.1.2 server-game jar for every vanilla method in scope, source comparison against versions/26.1.2/crates/, and checks of the prepared 26.1.2 data (versions/26.1.2/.local/horizon-client/26.1.2/). Oracle status quoted PROVISIONALLY from the 26.1.1 Batch 0 table (docs/sweep/26.1.2/batch-0-oracles.json had not landed when this batch finished; oracle sources are byte-identical between the trees, the vanilla API surface they compile against is unchanged, and every anchor was re-verified fresh against the 26.1.2 jars). Jardiff-first: 26.1.1->26.1.2 server-game jardiff = 3 changed classes (DetectedVersion, SharedConstants, ServerGamePacketListenerImpl), no entity class changed; tree diff 32 files, none in Batch 3 scope. A JVM-free class parser extracted the 20 BABY_DIMENSIONS declarers fresh; EntityType.<clinit> was parsed for all 157 entity types; Attributes.<clinit> for all 35 attributes; SpawnPlacements registrations for all 82 calls. Behaviour/non-behaviour split: 95 behaviour checks (63 pass, 32 gap) + 3 driver-code checks (0 pass, 3 gap: G18, G19, G20).

systemic_note: The systemic thread from 26.1.1 is unchanged in 26.1.2 - the delta touched no Batch 3 file and no entity class, so all 45 of 26.1.1's Batch 3 items reproduce with fresh evidence: the 26.1.2 tree did NOT inherit the 26.1 tree's behaviour fixes - it carries 26.2/26.3-form behaviour the 26.1 tree deliberately removed. The regressions cluster exactly where 26.1's form differs from 26.2/26.3: tag-grounded behaviour for tags 26.1.2 lacks (G03, G14, G15, G32, G36, G44), component-form behaviour for components 26.1.2 data lacks (G33), 26.2-form tables (G30, G31, G46), moved gates (G29), and dropped 26.1-only code paths (G13, G35, G37, G38, G40, G41, G42, G43, G45). One NEW defect was found in 26.1.2 (G47, AI walk-target value - the 26.1 and 26.1.1 sweeps checked only the spawn table, which is correct; the AI path misses all five arms) and one NEW check passes (B8 handleAttack spectator early-return - the delta's one behaviour item, ported in the LAN hub, contradicting PORT-NOTES-26.1.2.md's 'remains unported' flag). The sharpest instances remain the two majors: B3-G22 (the #causes_suffocation tag gate, a startup blocker; #suppresses_bounce fails first) and B3-G14 (endermen never teleport). The oracle groups are the same thread on the test side, unchanged from 26.1: all 52 failing oracles reference 26.3-only APIs (EntityTypes holder, densityfunction package, record-form packets, 9-arg LocalPlayer, abstract Level.fuelValues, 26.3 tag fields) - mechanical repairs, not port defects.
